author: Praxis VI
title: Cross‑organ harness (test, v2): Robust metrics API with CSV emission
abstract: Re‑runs the Heart CSV emission (Praxis baseline + monolithic log1p 1500/2000 HVG) using a robust metrics wrapper that adapts to openproblems_metrics API; on failure, logs NaN metrics without raising.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.extend(['storage/praxis'])
from cross_organ_harness import run_on_h5ad

def test(adata):
    rows = run_on_h5ad('storage/system/human_train_solution.h5ad', organ='heart', out_csv=True)
    print("ROWS_JSON:", json.dumps(rows))
    return "Cross-organ Heart CSV emitted (robust)"
